title: Stop Saying "Very Small"! Another Word for Small #shorts
description:
Looking for another word for "very small"? Try one of these instead:
• Tiny: a tiny kitchen
• Microscopic: microscopic creatures
• Miniature: a miniature train

Which one is new to you? Tell me in the comments.
